rows.title: The extremal biharmonic index conjecture for trees
rows.statement:
Let $T_n$ be a tree on $n\geq 5$ vertices. Write $BH(G)$ for the biharmonic index of a graph $G$, and let $K_{1,n-1}$ and $P_n$ denote the star and path on $n$ vertices, respectively. **The extremal biharmonic index conjecture.**

$$
BH(K_{1,n-1})\leq BH(T_n)\leq BH(P_n),
$$

where equality on the left holds if and only if $T_n=K_{1,n-1}$, and equality on the right holds if and only if $T_n=P_n$. This conjecture concretizes Problem 6.3 of WLY; the supplied text gives no resolution, although the preceding theorem proves the lower bound for trees of sufficiently large diameter.
rows.source_name: Zhen Lin, “The biharmonic index of connected graphs”, arXiv:2110.09931 (2021).
